plan.subject: Understand the fundamental concepts and techniques of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, optimization methods, and applications.
plan.objective: Understand the fundamental concepts and techniques of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, optimization methods, and applications.

blocks.title: What is Linear Regression?
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation for understanding how to model continuous outputs using a linear relationship between input and output variables.
examples: Simple linear regression models the relationship between one input variable and one output.

blocks.title: Cost Function and Mean Squared Error
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function quantifies the difference between predicted and actual values, and MSE is a widely used differentiable and convex cost function for regression.
examples: The cost function, such as mean squared error (MSE), quantifies the difference between predicted and actual values.

blocks.title: Gradient Descent and Optimization
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is an iterative algorithm that minimizes the cost function by adjusting model parameters, which is essential for training linear regression models.
examples: Gradient descent is an iterative algorithm that minimizes the cost function by adjusting model parameters.

blocks.title: Linear Regression Modelling and Applications
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression models can be applied to real-world problems like housing price prediction, where the relationship between features and output is modeled using a linear function.
examples: The housing price prediction: x (feature) is used to predict the price.

blocks.title: Closed-Form Solution and Linear Algebra
blocks.teachingObjective: The closed-form solution provides an analytical way to find optimal parameters, and understanding linear algebra is essential for efficiently implementing and interpreting linear regression models.
